ModMetaData.name: Mythic Ages: Megafauna Bestiary
ModMetaData.author: Veterano
ModMetaData.description:
Enter the Mythic Ages, where ancient megafauna roam wild lands shaped by a forgotten project now remembered only as legend.
Hunt them, tame them, or raise them at your own risk. Their meat, milk, wool, hides, bones, horns, organs, spores, and stranger byproducts can become food, clothing, medicine, drugs, weapons, or wealth.
Built for runs from tribal to industrial colonies, Mythic Ages keeps wildlife dangerous, useful, and tied to a past still breathing in the wild.
